title: AI Cover Art Generator
summary: Make album cover art with AI. Describe your music, add the title and artist name, and Flick makes the square cover. See prompts for nine genres. Try it free.
body_markdown:
### Can I make an album cover with AI for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. Every cover on this page was made with GPT Image 2.5, which runs on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### What size should album cover art be?


Album covers are square, so set an image to the 1:1 ratio in Flick. Check your distributor's current rules for the minimum size, then raise the image's resolution or upscale it to reach that.


### Can AI put the album title on the cover?


Yes, when the title is written exactly in quotation marks with a place and a style for the type. Long titles and very small type are the most likely to come back wrong, so read every letter before you use a cover.


### Can I use my own photo on an AI album cover?


Yes. Upload the photo to a Flick canvas and cite it as a reference in an image prompt, then describe the treatment and the lettering you want. The model can keep the picture while changing the type, the colour or the background.


### How do I make an album cover look like my genre?


Name what the genre's covers are made from: an engraving for metal, a photocopy for punk, a flat Swiss poster for techno. A medium and an era steer the model further than a mood word like dark or dreamy does.


### Can I release music with an AI album cover?


Rules differ by distributor and by the tool you used, so read your distributor's artwork rules and the terms of your image tool first. Keep real artists' names, faces and logos out of the prompt, so the cover looks like your own record and no one else's.
